name: Co-draw copying awaits completion and selects the code when clipboard access fails
description: Controlled Clipboard API outcomes verify application feedback without asserting physical OS clipboard interoperability. Use real LAN invite generation; unsupported WebRTC or unavailable outcome controls must report BLOCKED.

planSteps.description: Open Studio in an isolated desktop context.
Open the Co-Draw session dialog from Studio options.
Generate a Local LAN invite code using real browser WebRTC.
A nonempty read-only invite code is present. Capture its full value.
Configure navigator.clipboard.writeText to reject with NotAllowedError. If outcome controls are unavailable, report BLOCKED.
Manual-copy feedback appears and Copied success is absent. The code field is focused and selects the full captured value.
Configure writeText to return a controlled pending promise that captures its input.
Copying remains pending with a disabled button and no success before resolution. The captured input exactly equals the full invite code.
Invite code copied is announced only after resolution and the previous error disappears.
No stale copied status remains. Existing artwork and saved identity are unchanged.
